data.name: Verónica
data.gender_notes: Verónica is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Verus (true) and Ikos (image), Verónica means 'true image' in Christianity. In biblical legend, Verónica wiped the face of Jesus as He carried the cross, leaving a miraculous imprint of His face on her cloth. She is revered as a saint in the Catholic and Orthodox Churches. The name Verónica carries the meaning “True image” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Verónica usually hope their child will grow to embody true image and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Verónica belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “True image.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Verónica total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: ורוניקה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ורוניקה (Verónica) היא שם נשי שמקורו בשם היווני Βηροنية (Verónike), המורכב מהמילים βέρος (bérós, 'אהבה') ו-νίκη (níkē, 'ניצחון'). בעברית, השם ורוניקה משמר את משמעות המקורית ומתאר אמה אשר מציגה רחמים ונאמנות, והיא שם שכיח בקרב הכנסייה היוונית. כיום, השם ורוניקה נפוץ גם בקרב הכנסיות הלטינית והסלבית, והוא מראה על חסד, רחמים ואמונה.

in_greek.name: Βηροنية
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βηροنية (Verónike) προέρχεται από τα αρχαία ελληνικά και αποτελείται από τα λόγια βέρος (bérós, 'αγάπη') και νίκη (níkē, 'νίκη'). Στη χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Βηροنية συνδέεται με την αγάπη και την πίστη, και θεωρείται ότι περιγράφει την αρετή της Βηρονίκης, της μητέρας του Ιησού. Σήμερα, το όνομα Βηροنية χρησιμοποιείται ευρέως σε όλη την Ορθόδοξη Εκκλησία και αντιπροσωπεύει τη χάρη του Θεού, την αγάπη και την πίστη.

in_latin.name: Verónica
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Veronicae a vocabulis Graecis βέρος (bérós, 'amor') et νίκη (níkē, 'victoria') componitur. In Ecclesia Latina, nomen Veronicae significat caritatem et fidem, et est vocabulum commune in Ecclesia Catholica. Hodie, nomen Veronicae in Ecclesiis Latinis et Graecis diffusum est, et indicat misericordiam, caritatem et fidem.

in_english.name: Verónica
in_english.long_meaning: The name Verónica comes from the Greek words βέρος (bérós, 'love') and νίκη (níkē, 'victory'). In Christian tradition, the name Verónica is associated with love, faith, and charity, and is said to describe the virtues of Mary, the mother of Jesus. Today, the name Verónica is popular in many Christian cultures and represents the gift of God, love, and faith.
